title: activation-metrics.report template variables
description: Values for templates/activation-metrics.report.md.j2 and templates/activation-metrics.report.html.j2. Generated by tpl-jinja from activation-metrics.report.md; `description` on each property is the question put to the author.

activation_event_name.title: Activation event name
activation_event_name.description: The tracked activation event (snake_case) from the activation-framework spec. From section 'Definition and period'.

data_cutoff.title: Data cutoff
data_cutoff.description: Date the data was pulled, YYYY-MM-DD. From section 'Definition and period'.

period_end.title: Period end
period_end.description: Last signup date in the period, YYYY-MM-DD; period_end + window_days must be on or before data_cutoff. From section 'Definition and period'.

period_start.title: Period start
period_start.description: First signup date in the period, YYYY-MM-DD. From section 'Definition and period'.

sample_floor.title: Sample floor
sample_floor.description: Minimum signups a channel needs before its rate is compared. From section 'Definition and period'.

window_days.title: Window days
window_days.description: Activation window in days from signup, used by every metric. From section 'Definition and period'.
